query: INSERT INTO dashboard_layouts (account_id, revision, panel_order, note_visible, connections_visible, pins_visible) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET revision = EXCLUDED.revision, panel_order = EXCLUDED.panel_order, note_visible = EXCLUDED.note_visible, connections_visible = EXCLUDED.connections_visible, pins_visible = EXCLUDED.pins_visible
